# spov-msedge.net
> Microsoft Edge support and content delivery domain serving Edge-related help, assets, and web experiences.

This domain is used by Microsoft Edge for support content, onboarding flows, and related web resources surfaced in the browser and Microsoft web properties.

## Support
- [Microsoft Edge Support](https://spov-msedge.net/): Entry point for Edge-related support and web experiences.
- [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge): Official Microsoft Edge help and troubleshooting resources.
- [Microsoft Edge Help](https://support.microsoft.com/topic/microsoft-edge-help): General help articles for using Microsoft Edge.
- [Fix Problems in Microsoft Edge](https://support.microsoft.com/search?query=Microsoft%20Edge): Search-based support results for Edge issues and troubleshooting.

## Edge Features
- [Browse with Microsoft Edge](https://www.microsoft.com/edge): Product overview for Microsoft Edge browser features and downloads.
- [Microsoft Edge Features](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/features): Overview of productivity, security, and AI-powered browser capabilities.
- [Microsoft Edge Security](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/business/security): Security features and protections available in Microsoft Edge.
- [Microsoft Edge AI Features](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/features/ai-powered): AI-powered browsing and Copilot-related Edge capabilities.

## Business and Enterprise
- [Microsoft Edge for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/business): Enterprise-focused Edge browser information and deployment resources.
- [Edge Business Security](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/business/security): Security controls, protections, and enterprise browser management overview.
- [Edge Business Download](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/business/download): Download Microsoft Edge for Business builds and channels.
- [Microsoft Edge Enterprise Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/): Technical documentation for deploying and managing Edge in organizations.
- [Edge Release Notes for Enterprises](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-stable-channel): Stable channel release notes for enterprise administrators.

## Deployment and Management
- [Configure Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/configure-microsoft-edge): Administrative configuration guidance for Microsoft Edge deployments.
- [Microsoft Edge Policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies): Reference for browser policies available to administrators.
- [Update Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-update-policies): Policy reference for Microsoft Edge update management.
- [Manage Extensions in Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-manage-extensions): Guidance for controlling and managing browser extensions.
- [Edge on Windows Autopilot and Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/mem/intune/apps/manage-microsoft-edge): Intune management guidance for Microsoft Edge applications.

## Developer Documentation
- [Microsoft Edge Developer](https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/): Developer hub for building, testing, and optimizing web experiences in Edge.
- [Microsoft Edge DevTools Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/devtools-guide-chromium/): Documentation for debugging and profiling with Edge DevTools.
- [WebView2 Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/): Documentation for embedding web content using Microsoft Edge WebView2.
- [Microsoft Edge Extensions](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/extensions-chromium/): Documentation for building and publishing Edge browser extensions.
- [Edge Web Platform Status](https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/platform/status/): Feature support and implementation status for web platform capabilities.

## API and Reference
- [WebView2 API Reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.web.webview2.core): .NET API reference for Microsoft Edge WebView2 components.
- [Edge DevTools Protocol](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/devtools-protocol-chromium/): Protocol documentation for automation and debugging integrations.
- [Microsoft Edge Policy Reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies): Complete administrative policy reference for Edge.
- [WebView2 Samples and Reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/reference/): Reference materials and links for WebView2 SDK usage.

## Downloads
- [Download Microsoft Edge](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/download): Official Microsoft Edge browser download page.
- [Download Edge for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/business/download): Business and enterprise download options for Edge.
- [Download Edge Insider Channels](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/download/insider): Download preview builds from Edge Insider channels.
- [WebView2 Download](https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/): Access WebView2 runtime and SDK download resources.

## Insider and Release Channels
- [Microsoft Edge Insider](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/download/insider): Preview channels for testing upcoming Edge releases.
- [Edge Stable Release Notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-stable-channel): Stable channel release history and changes.
- [Edge Beta Release Notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-beta-channel): Beta channel release notes for pre-release validation.
- [Edge Dev Release Notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-dev-channel): Dev channel release notes for early testing.
- [Edge Security Updates](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/en-us): Microsoft Security Response Center update guidance including Edge-related fixes.

## Community and Learning
- [Microsoft Edge Blog](https://blogs.windows.com/msedgedev/): Announcements, feature updates, and developer-focused Edge news.
- [Microsoft Learn: Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/search/?terms=Microsoft%20Edge): Search results across Microsoft Learn for Edge topics.
- [Microsoft Q&A](https://learn.microsoft.com/answers/tags/255/microsoft-edge): Community questions and answers related to Microsoft Edge.
- [Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/Microsoft-Edge-Extensions-Home): Extension marketplace for Microsoft Edge.
